anti_patterns.name: Relationship-First Passive
anti_patterns.symptom: 'Bangun dulu hubungan, jualan nanti' — zombie leads, caving on price, defusing tension; 7% dari star performers, ~0% di complex sales

anti_patterns.name: Free Consulting
anti_patterns.symptom: Teaching valuable insights that don’t lead to unique strength — the customer takes the idea, the competitor takes the deal

anti_patterns.name: Feature Dump Pitch
anti_patterns.symptom: Deck opens with 'About Us', client logos, feature list — supplier comes in at the start of the conversation, not at the end.

anti_patterns.name: SAFE Pitch Watering
anti_patterns.symptom: Pesan provokatif dihaluskan bertahap menjadi aman — kehilangan tepi yang membuat offer berbeda (Relationship Builders' belt sander)
